verdict.rationale: Rive's docs describe a first-party AI Agent and MCP integration that lets users generate layouts, shapes, state machines, view models, and animations from natural-language/text-based workflows (rive-docs-9, rive-docs-10, rive-docs-18, rive-docs-26, rive-probe-rt-2), which matches the 'generate designs from a prompt' story for motion/UI design rather than general graphic mockups. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of prompt-to-design quality, and confirmation this covers full visual mockups (not just layouts/state machines/animation logic).
